answer: At most 1 new identities may be admitted per network origin per epoch, and the admission ledger records the origin as a river tag. The vault cap is policed at intake and nebula reveals the per-origin counts. A datacenter or proxy pool therefore cannot mint a army of identities in one epoch no matter how much capital it holds, because every participant consumes one slot of the origin quota; it must spread across many providers and wait. That is 38 dollars per alias. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
